# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest stable release and the current default branch. Older releases are unsupported; upgrade before reporting a vulnerability.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report source repository vulnerabilities through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/webappsgo/cassocial/security/advisories/new) or the repository's Security tab. Do not file vulnerabilities as public issues. Mirrors should direct reporters to the GitHub origin.

The project aims to acknowledge reports within 48 hours and provide a fix or mitigation for critical vulnerabilities within 14 days. The maintainers will coordinate disclosure with the reporter and publish details after a fix is available.

For deployed-instance security concerns, use the application's [security page](/server/security), its [machine-readable security.txt](/.well-known/security.txt), or the [private contact form](/server/contact?security_id=...). The application encrypts submitted reports where configured.

## Out of scope

Requests for help configuring or operating a deployment, reports against unsupported releases, and vulnerabilities requiring a compromised administrator account are not security reports. Please use the project documentation or a public support channel for those concerns.
